purpose: Make release, CI, security, rollback, and handoff evidence visible in SEIS Command Center before work is treated as shippable.

summaryCards.evidence: Work package, handoff, changelog, and source boundary are visible.
Local gates pass; GitHub code scanning and branch protection remain external evidence.
No-secret policy, permission review, and access model checks stay attached to release decisions.
Rollback path is tied to commit scope, generated reports, and adapter boundaries.

checks.name: Source boundary
checks.evidence: git status --short and reversible commit scope

checks.name: Security posture
checks.evidence: enterprise gates, access model, dependency scan records

checks.name: External CI
checks.evidence: remote checks and code scanning results

checks.name: Handoff proof
checks.evidence: commit hash, push result, next command, and rollback note

completionRule: Operations readiness can move from review-before-release to release-ready only after local quality, clean source boundary, push evidence, external CI or explicit no-CI handoff evidence, and rollback proof are all visible.
